maps.label: Ball recoveries
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source colors and legend retained

context.title: Ball recoveries — location distribution
context.measurement: Where the team regained possession across the reported sample.
context.units: Large zone % = share of all team recoveries. Small zone number = recoveries per match. Outer labels show shares by third/channel.
context.legend: Source legend: blue = more than league average; red = less than league average. Numerical league benchmarks are not provided.
context.orientation: Source pitch arrow points left to right; outer percentages identify the source thirds and channels.
context.limit: Map team coverage can differ from outfield-player totals. Recovery location alone does not establish block height or pressing triggers.

maps.label: Possession losses
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source colors and legend retained

context.title: Possession losses — location distribution
context.measurement: Where possession losses were recorded, not where defensive duels were lost.
context.units: Large zone % = share of all team possession losses. Small zone number = losses per match. Outer labels show shares by third/channel.
context.legend: Source legend: blue = less than league average; red = more than league average. Numerical league benchmarks are not provided.
context.orientation: Original left-to-right source pitch orientation is retained.
context.limit: Possession losses and lost defensive duels have different definitions and denominators. These are not match-specific losses or causal player errors.

maps.label: Dribble locations
maps.kind: Original PDF pitch crop; complete legend restated in viewer

context.title: Dribbling — locations and success
context.measurement: All reported dribble attempts, successful and unsuccessful, across the pitch.
context.units: Large zone % = share of all team dribble attempts, not success rate. Small top number = dribbles per match. Paired inner percentages = successful/unsuccessful attempts within that zone. Outer labels = shares by third/channel.
context.legend: Source legend: green/salmon = successful/unsuccessful; blue/red = better/worse than league average. Numerical league benchmarks are unavailable. These distinct percentages must not be combined.
context.orientation: Original source orientation retained. The full source title and wide legend are shown above the pitch crop.
context.limit: A location share does not show the direction of a carry or prove a route into central space. Team attempt shares differ from the selected-player successful final-third dribble table.

maps.label: Foul locations
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source colors and legend retained

context.title: Fouls committed — location distribution
context.measurement: Locations of fouls committed by the team over the sample.
context.units: Large zone % = share of all team fouls committed. Small zone number = fouls per match; outer labels are third/channel shares.
context.legend: Source legend: blue = less than league average; red = more than league average. Numerical league benchmarks are not provided.
context.orientation: Original left-to-right source pitch orientation is retained.
context.limit: Colors compare reported frequency with a provider benchmark, not overall defensive quality. The map does not identify a pressing trigger.

maps.label: Won defensive actions in own third
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source colors and legend retained

context.title: Won own-third defensive actions
context.original_title: Won defensive duels in own third
context.measurement: Reported own-third defensive-duel wins, interceptions and sliding tackles.
context.units: Event symbols and player shirt numbers; no spatial-rate or percentage denominator is supplied.
context.legend: Source legend: circle = defensive duel; square = interception; diamond = sliding tackle. Shirt numbers identify players, not action counts.
context.orientation: Only the source own-third pitch section is shown; preserve its original defending-goal orientation.
context.limit: This mixed-action map is not the denominator for the complete all-area defensive-duel win rate. Marker density is not adjusted for opponent attacking exposure.

maps.label: Lost duels in own third
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source colors and legend retained

context.title: Lost own-third duels and subsequent annotations
context.measurement: Locations of reported lost own-third duels with provider annotations for shots, fouls and cards.
context.units: Source event markers and shirt numbers, not a rate per opponent attack or a complete opponent xG total.
context.legend: Source legend: outlined square = opponent shot after; outlined diamond = foul; yellow/red diamond = yellow/red card. Shirt numbers identify players.
context.orientation: Only the source own-third pitch section is shown; preserve its original defending-goal orientation.
context.limit: Subsequent-shot annotations do not prove individual fault. No rate is inferred from mixed marker types or estimated opportunity counts.

maps.label: Attacking-third recoveries
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source title, markers and legend retained

context.title: Attacking-third recoveries
context.measurement: Source-reported possession recoveries in the opponent’s final third across the report sample.
context.units: Event markers, not zone percentages or per-match rates. Shirt numbers identify players.
context.legend: Source legend: filled square = positional pressing; open circle = with shot; diamond = goal. Original source symbols and colors are retained.
context.orientation: Opponent final third, with the opponent goal at the top; original source orientation retained.
context.limit: Five-match aggregate, not match-specific. The accompanying player table is a selected list and cannot establish a complete team total. Recovery location alone does not establish a pressing mechanism or recurrence.

maps.label: Crosses
maps.kind: Original PDF map crop; source title, legend and measurements retained

context.title: Crosses
context.measurement: Source-reported crossing actions in the opponent’s final third.
context.units: Source event markers and shirt numbers, not zone percentages or per-match rates.
context.legend: Successful / unsuccessful; dashed line = high cross; solid line = ground cross. Source symbols and shirt numbers are retained.
context.orientation: Opponent final third; opponent goal at the top. Source orientation retained.
context.limit: Five-match aggregate, not match-specific. Associated shots and goals are team outcomes; the named actor is not necessarily the shooter. Selected-player tables are not complete team totals.

context.title: Successful dribbles in final third
context.measurement: Source-reported successful dribbles in the opponent’s final third, with associated shot and goal markers.
context.units: Source event markers and shirt numbers, not zone percentages or per-match rates.
context.legend: Open circle = with shot; diamond = goal. Original source symbols and shirt numbers are retained.
context.orientation: Opponent final third; opponent goal at the top. Source orientation retained.
context.limit: Five-match aggregate, not match-specific. Associated shots and goals are team outcomes; the named actor is not necessarily the shooter. Selected-player tables are not complete team totals.
